data.one_liner: Microsoft Authentication Library wrapper for Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Wraps the Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL) for Android and iOS to let users sign in and acquire tokens. Supports public client application functionality using the implicit workflow, interactive token acquisition, silent token acquisition, and logout.
use_when: You need to authenticate users via Microsoft Azure AD / B2C in a Flutter mobile application
You require interactive or silent token acquisition using native MSAL libraries on Android and iOS
avoid_when: You need free support or pull request reviews, as maintenance is limited and the package comes as-is
You need functionality outside of public client applications and implicit workflow
strengths: Provides direct integration with official MSAL libraries for Android and iOS
Supports Azure AD B2C tenants and custom authorities
weaknesses: Maintainers do not offer free support or review PRs
Early stage / wrapper nature means bugs may require forking to fix
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Azure AD B2C, configuring AndroidManifest.xml with intent filters and raw JSON config, updating Gradle and Kotlin versions, modifying iOS Info.plist, adding Keychain Sharing capabilities, and modifying AppDelegate.swift.
